summary: Alpha Modus Holdings filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter dated October 1, 2026, stating the company complies with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) following its prior 8-K. Nasdaq cautioned that failure to evidence continued compliance in the next periodic report could trigger delisting. No terms, prices, stakes, advisors, or board recommendations were disclosed. The filing is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation; watch for the next periodic report's equity evidence and any subsequent deficiency notice.
